This plot is small, only a third of a hectare, and I am planting beans. Beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does — my mother taught me they make their own food from the soil. I have some cattle manure from last season that I will spread before planting, and I will save my cash and any FISP coupon for the maize plot where it matters more. I will use seed I kept from last harvest because the beans did well, and my daughter and I will do the weeding ourselves.
